name: allchat-streamdeck-plugin
description: Elgato Stream Deck plugin for All-Chat: send chat messages and drive polls / predictions from hardware keys.
//dependencies: The build toolchain sits in dependencies rather than devDependencies on purpose. This package is private and never published, and CI runs with NODE_ENV=production, under which npm ci omits dev dependencies and npm run build would fail with 'tsc: not found'. Nothing listed here ships to a user as a package: the distributable is the .sdPlugin folder, which contains only the manifest and the single bundled bin/plugin.js. @elgato/streamdeck and its transitive deps are inlined into that bundle by scripts/build.mjs, because the .sdPlugin folder has no node_modules for a bare import to resolve against. ws is listed directly because scripts/smoke.mjs imports it to impersonate the Stream Deck host; it is a transitive dep of the SDK too, but the test must not rely on npm hoisting it.
